plants.title: Futura Superba Snake Plant
plants.description: Compact architectural foliage featuring broad, silver-green leaves with luminous golden-yellow margins. Celebrated by NASA studies for oxygen release throughout the night and remarkable resilience in modern living spaces.
plants.careTip: Highly drought-tolerant; allow potting mix to dry out thoroughly between waterings.
plants.idealPlacement: Bedroom nightstand, workspace desk, or living room shelf.

plants.title: Golden Money Plant
plants.description: Lush cascading heart-shaped leaves marbled with radiant sunny gold and emerald tones. Cherished in Vastu and Feng Shui principles for inviting vitality, prosperity, and restorative biophilic greenery.
plants.careTip: Trim trailing vines occasionally to promote dense, bushy crown foliage.
plants.idealPlacement: Bookshelf ledge, office worktop, or bright entryway console.

plants.title: Potted Desert Cactus
plants.description: Sculptural ribbed desert succulent potted in mineral-rich volcanic pumice and porous clay grit. Perfectly acclimatized for warm, sunny balconies and bright interior spaces across West Bengal and India.
plants.careTip: Needs ample light and zero standing moisture; water only when substrate is completely bone-dry.
plants.idealPlacement: Sunlit windowsill, open balcony table, or sunny coffee table.

plants.title: Miniature Garden Rose
plants.description: Ever-blooming compact rose specimen producing delicate, scented crimson blossoms. Nurtured in nutrient-dense organic vermicompost for steady bud formation and vibrant petal clarity.
plants.careTip: Deadhead spent flowers regularly to stimulate abundant continuous blooms.
plants.idealPlacement: Well-ventilated sunny balcony, patio planter, or bright window garden.

aquariums.title: 3ft Rimless Opti-White Tank
aquariums.description: Handcrafted ultra-clear low-iron glass tank assembled with German high-tensile clear silicone seams and 45° diamond-beveled edges for an invisible aquatic boundary.
aquariums.idealPlacement: Living room focal wall, studio reception, or private consultation gallery.
aquariums.aquascapingTip: Zero greenish tint on glass edges reveals pure natural moss and aquatic flora greens.

aquariums.title: Nano Desktop Cube 30C
aquariums.description: Tranquil miniature water garden tailored for executive desks and quiet nightstands. Perfect for delicate Neocaridina shrimp and lush Anubias nana petite.
aquariums.idealPlacement: Executive work desk, bedside sanctuary table, or library shelf.
aquariums.aquascapingTip: Includes high-density leveling mat to protect wooden desks from vibrations.

aquariums.title: 4ft Panoramic Planted Tank & Cabinet
aquariums.description: Flagship showcase tank paired with a water-resistant matte black aluminum-framed cabinet. Includes soft-close hinges, internal sump routing, and leveling feet.
aquariums.idealPlacement: Main living room wall, corporate boardroom, or luxury foyer.
aquariums.aquascapingTip: Engineered for high-tech Dutch or Nature Aquarium layouts with hidden tubing paths.

aquariums.title: Dragon Stone Riverbed Scape Tank
aquariums.description: Pre-assembled natural hardscape featuring hand-chiseled aged Dragon Stone formations and Malaysian spiderwood pinned on fine cosmetic quartz river sand.
aquariums.idealPlacement: Study table, entryway console, or lounge coffee bar.
aquariums.aquascapingTip: Cured and water-tested; ready to flood immediately without cloudiness.

aquariums.title: 2ft Shallow Bonsai Riparium Tank
aquariums.description: Shallow rimless profile designed for emergent bog plants, terrestrial mosses, and floating red-root floaters viewed from top and side angles.
aquariums.idealPlacement: Bright conservatory, dining credenza, or balcony nook.
aquariums.aquascapingTip: Ideal for cascading waterfalls, driftwood branch emergence, and serene mist makers.

aquariums.title: Mini 20C Desktop Zen Cube
aquariums.description: Delicate miniature zen cube. Ideal for marimo moss balls, small freshwater snails, and calming meditation desks.
aquariums.idealPlacement: Compact office workstation, bedroom nightstand, or study nook.
aquariums.aquascapingTip: Compact footprint fits anywhere. Requires only 2 minutes weekly maintenance.
